g.text: Symmetric: a reversed telephone cord cannot swap +5V and GND,

g.desc: Symmetric: a reversed telephone cord cannot swap +5V and GND,

g.text: it only swaps A and B - the firmware detects it and inverts

g.desc: it only swaps A and B - the firmware detects it and inverts

g.text: J2: the cord is soldered to the board (no jack: the board sits at 45 deg

g.desc: J2: the cord is soldered to the board (no jack: the board sits at 45 deg

g.text: under the desk edge, the cord leaves flat along the desk). Keep the

g.desc: under the desk edge, the cord leaves flat along the desk). Keep the

g.text: flat order, either direction works. Cable tie through the two slots.

g.desc: flat order, either direction works. Cable tie through the two slots.

g.text: SW1 Up SW2 Down SW3..SW5 presets 1..3

g.desc: SW1 Up SW2 Down SW3..SW5 presets 1..3

g.text: To GND, RP2040 internal pull-ups, debounced in firmware.

g.desc: To GND, RP2040 internal pull-ups, debounced in firmware.

g.text: VCC = 5 V as before: the module regulates its own 3.3 V.

g.desc: VCC = 5 V as before: the module regulates its own 3.3 V.

g.text: Logic: 3.3 V from the RP2040 (SPI0, 20 MHz).

g.desc: Logic: 3.3 V from the RP2040 (SPI0, 20 MHz).

g.text: First flash: hold BOOT (SW6), plug the USB-C, release -> USB drive, copy firmware.uf2.

g.desc: First flash: hold BOOT (SW6), plug the USB-C, release -> USB drive, copy firmware.uf2.

g.text: Link protocol: shared/hmi_link/hmi_protocol.h (250 kbaud, motherboard polls every 10 ms).

g.desc: Link protocol: shared/hmi_link/hmi_protocol.h (250 kbaud, motherboard polls every 10 ms).

g.text: PCB: J1, SW1-SW5, TP2-TP6 keep their footprints; FPC_HMI1 is replaced by J2 (RJ11).

g.desc: PCB: J1, SW1-SW5, TP2-TP6 keep their footprints; FPC_HMI1 is replaced by J2 (RJ11).

g.text: Link to the motherboard: RS-485 over an RJ11 cord

g.desc: Link to the motherboard: RS-485 over an RJ11 cord

g.text: SWD: TP7 SWCLK, TP8 SWDIO, TP10 GND, TP9 RUN

g.desc: SWD: TP7 SWCLK, TP8 SWDIO, TP10 GND, TP9 RUN

g.text: D1: the USB-C only powers the board for flashing;

g.desc: D1: the USB-C only powers the board for flashing;

g.text: with the cord in, the 5 V comes from the motherboard

g.desc: with the cord in, the 5 V comes from the motherboard

g.text: (D1 stops it flowing back into the PC).

g.desc: (D1 stops it flowing back into the PC).

g.text: J2: 1, 6 = +5V 2, 5 = GND (power symbols at the pins)

g.desc: J2: 1, 6 = +5V 2, 5 = GND (power symbols at the pins)

g.text: C6-C11: IOVDD x6 C12: USB_VDD C13: ADC_AVDD C14: VREG_VIN

g.desc: C6-C11: IOVDD x6 C12: USB_VDD C13: ADC_AVDD C14: VREG_VIN

g.text: C15: flash C16: VREG_VOUT C17-C18: DVDD x2

g.desc: C15: flash C16: VREG_VOUT C17-C18: DVDD x2

g.text: (one per pin, as close to it as possible)

g.desc: (one per pin, as close to it as possible)

g.text: R1 (DNP): 120R termination, only for cords over ~5 m

g.desc: R1 (DNP): 120R termination, only for cords over ~5 m

g.text: (the 4.7k bias resistors on the motherboard then become 680R)
